name: Syensqo
note: DS Penske partner (Season 12, 2025/26; Syensqo lists its Formula E partnership on its own site). Left unrated for a maintainer: the largest shareholder is sourced (syensqo-ownership: Solvac SA, 30.81%), but the company test isn't settled. Syensqo took over Solvay's Spinetta Marengo plant in Italy at the 2023 demerger. In December 2015 an Italian court found Solvay managers guilty of causing environmental damage there and ordered Solvay to compensate residents; the Court of Cassation upheld the verdict in 2019 (ICIJ, https://www.icij.org/investigations/pandora-papers/solvay-italy-new-jerey-chemical-plants-offshore/). Two former plant directors were sent to trial in 2026 over PFAS pollution (no verdict yet).
